subject: Sycamore — urgent: AZ2 latency spike, request cross-region fallback & exec sync
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elenaruiz@sycamore.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: High error rate + token throttling in us-east-2 AZ2 (customer-impacting)

Hi Kimberly —

We're seeing sustained 5xxs and a sharp drop in throughput starting ~08:50 ET across our production fleet that pins to us-east-2 (AZ2). Latency for completion endpoints has jumped from ~120ms p50 to ~2.4s p50 and 10s p95; error rate is ~6% for the last 22 minutes. Bearing in mind we have active billing traffic and customer-facing features depending on consistent latency, a number of enterprise customers reported timeouts.

Attached is a short sample (sycamore-error-sample.log) and a CSV with request counts by minute. Can you escalate to operations and advise next steps (cross-region fallback, temporary throttles, or credits)? This is starting to look like an AZ-level disruption.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform — Sycamore AI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elenaruiz@sycamore.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 09:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + token throttling in us-east-2 AZ2 (customer-impacting)

Folks —

Elena flagged a customer-impacting spike in AZ2. Rishi / Hannah: can we get a quick triage summary (root signals: routing, hardware, KVCACHE, queued QPS) and whether an automatic fallback to a compatible model in us-east-1 would be safe for Sycamore's production workload?

Marcus / Dylan: if we need to initiate cross-region fallback, we need an exec-facing note and proposed customer communication + recommended credits. Sycamore is on a committed reserved plan (SYC-4821) — please treat this as priority.

I will pull in Leadership if we need any deviation from standard credit policy.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 09:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + token throttling in us-east-2 AZ2 (customer-impacting)

Quick summary from runtime telemetry (first pass):
- Error spikes correlate with a subset of host pools in us-east-2 (AZ2). Network-level retries increased 3x; we are seeing KVCACHE miss amplification on several g4x nodes.
- No obvious model code regression pushed in the last 48 hours.
- Autoscale attempted additional allocation but some allocation requests timed out.

Immediate options:
1) Controlled cross-region fallback to us-east-1 for Sycamore production routes with sticky session TTL = 10m. This preserves service but may change p95 latency by ~100-300ms depending on inter-region path.
2) Short-term traffic thinning (rate-limit lower-priority routes per MAT - mutual action plan) to relieve AZ2 pressure while we remediate.
3) If fallback is done, recommend preemptive warmup (KV prefill for top prefixes) to reduce cold-start amplification.

I'll stand up a runtime bridge; Hannah, can you confirm any active maintenance windows in us-east-1 that would prevent fallback?

Rishi
Senior Runtime Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 10:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + token throttling in us-east-2 AZ2 (customer-impacting)

us-east-1 is nominal — no maintenance affecting capacity. We can accept routed traffic. Two operational asks if we fallback:
- Pre-warm top 20 prefixes for Sycamore (Rishi can kick this).
- Toggle read-mode KV cache TTLs to aggressive (60s) during the first 15 minutes to prevent miss storms.

I'll coordinate with infra to ensure allocations for Sycamore get priority label so autoscaler doesn't mix with best-effort pools.

Hannah
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elenaruiz@sycamore.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 10:37:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + token throttling in us-east-2 AZ2 (customer-impacting)

Proposal for exec note + customer comms:
- Exec ask: approval to run controlled cross-region fallback for SYC-4821 to us-east-1 for up to 3 hours, followed by a post-mortem and potential one-time credit (TBD).
- Impact: expected p95 delta +150ms; expected measurable drop in error rate to <0.5% once KVCACHE prefill completes.
- Customer-facing comms: short bulletin explaining we detected a regional capacity degradation in AZ2, we routed production traffic to an adjacent region to maintain service while we remediate, and we're investigating root cause. Offer a one-time credit (0.5% of monthly committed spend) conditional on post-mortem findings.

If leadership signs off on the above, we will execute fallback now. Request Kimberly to confirm authorization level for credits (if any change from standard).

Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elenaruiz@sycamore.ai>, Alex Chen <alex@sycamore.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + token throttling in us-east-2 AZ2 (customer-impacting)

Thanks team — I authorize Marcus's proposal: initiate a controlled cross-region fallback for Sycamore (SYC-4821) to us-east-1 now.

Marissa / Finance: please provision the one-time credit hold as a pro-forma (0.5% of monthly committed spend) pending post-mortem. Do not finalize until the root cause call and leadership sign-off on final remediation credit.

Marissa: please draft the short customer bulletin (2-3 paragraphs) and I'll review before we send to Elena to share with her stakeholders.

Elena — we will start the fallback in the next 10 minutes, and expect visible improvements within ~12 minutes of warmup. We'll keep you updated on the post-mortem. Apologies for the disruption; we recognise the impact.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
